candidates.title: Annadale Open Space PEACEPLUS capital project was unveiled
candidates.summary: Belfast City Council's 20 September 2024 PEACEPLUS news page recorded Annadale Open Space among five local areas where capital works and activity projects were included in the PEACEPLUS Local Action Plan.
candidates.observed_change: A documented council programme milestone identified Annadale Open Space as a PEACEPLUS community regeneration capital-project location.
candidates.geometry_source: Approximate point on Annadale Embankment from the council-stated project location; no official project polygon was exposed by the source pages.
candidates.geometry_precision: Approximate project-location point, not a surveyed works boundary, playpark layout, community-facility footprint, pathway line, or land parcel.
candidates.source_name: Transformative Belfast PEACEPLUS projects unveiled during Good Relations Week
candidates.source_record_id: PEACEPLUS news page, 20 September 2024: Annadale Open Space capital works/activity project
candidates.license: Belfast City Council website copyright and terms; factual project metadata and source URLs retained for audit.
candidates.architect: Belfast City Council, PEACEPLUS programme partners, and local project teams; designer and construction partners not named in the cited source pages.
candidates.limitations: This is a programme-inclusion and project-unveiling record. It does not document planning approval, construction start, handover, opening, final design, as-built layout, public access, or a completed open-space condition.
candidates.caveats: Use as an administrative programme milestone only. Keep it separate from approvals, starts, completions, openings and final built form.

candidates.transformation_method: Round332 manual official-source sweep; source pages were fetched for availability and markers, candidate terms were checked against the current manual corpus and prior Belfast packs, and two distinct non-duplicate programme milestones were normalized with approximate point geometry.
